items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is not an insured peril (2.1, 3.1.4); clothing/jewellery are personal effects (4.3(d)) located in a conveyance away from the insured location (4.3(f)). Identical to reference case 35, which was not indemnified.
Conveyance-related costs excluded (4.3(e), 5.2.5, 7.1.8(d)) and no insured event; case 35 identical, not indemnified.
